description: Returns a roster anyone may open, by an id from list_public_rosters or from a roster link someone shared: public and unlisted rosters, never private ones. summary names each unit with its points, models, wargear, enhancements, Warlord and attachments, and gives the total and any problems under today's army data; it is null while army data is unavailable. roster holds the choices by catalogue id, the shape check_roster, grade_roster, compare_rosters and save_roster take, so grade it or set it against another list rather than judging it yourself.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: get_public_roster
title: Read a public roster
